headline: Drones Strike Russian Oil Refinery and Hub
summary: Long-range drones attacked the Novoshakhtinsk Oil Refinery and the Samara oil hub in Russia, causing fires and operational disruptions.
why: Russia is a major global oil exporter; attacks on its energy infrastructure can disrupt supply chains and impact global crude oil prices.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Supply disruptions in major oil-producing regions typically drive prices higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical tensions and threats to energy supply infrastructure create uncertainty in global oil markets.
